Name: Joab, of Pahath-moab's Family
Summary: Head of a family line listed with Jeshua under Pahath-moab among the returnees (Ezra 2:6; Nehemiah 7:11). Not Joab, David's general.
LifeLesson: A namesake centuries later is a different man, and the record keeps them distinct.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile
